status: Analysis surfaces over declared ranges. NOT predictions, NOT an architecture ranking; no Hall closure, screening candidate or absolute Hall number is used. Hall-only efficiency components are analysis parameters.

milestones.A: conditional selection: identifies regions where no pre-ionizer can pay for itself in power under the most favourable corner of the declared model family, and the conditions (utilization gain, ion cost, transport efficiency, overhead) an architecture must demonstrate to be baseline.
milestones.to_reach_B: admitted Hall transport closure(s) for Vyovrinda geometry giving eta_u0, eta_b, eta_v, gamma and their V_d dependence per credible-set member; measured or closure-derived alpha, chi, eta_v_S and delivered-ion mix; measured source ion cost and eta_transport on N2/O/O2 at the common feed state.
milestones.to_reach_C: power-system and thrust mass sensitivities, hardware masses, source and Hall life limits with evidence, thermal closure (thermal_life.py), startup/cathode, integrated mission closure.

boundary.note: the common feed state (mdot, species) is identical for hall_only, rf_hall, ecr_hall; Hall-closure uncertainty is confined to the ionization/acceleration block and never enters intake, compressor, gas chambers or valves.

rf_hall.overhead_O: P_bus[rf_source] + sum over common components (P_bus,arm - P_bus,hall_only) except hall_discharge (+ interstage, extra PPU: 0 in a v1-conformant ledger)

ecr_hall.overhead_O: P_bus[ecr_source] + P_bus[ecr_magnet] + common deltas (+ interstage, extra PPU: 0 in a v1-conformant ledger)
ecr_hall.ion_cost_split: generator = ecr_source; fixed = ecr_magnet + everything else (an electromagnet lowers the payable cost: see sup_C_del_star_over_Pi_H_with_fixed_overhead)

per_architecture.reading: the surfaces are functions of the total overhead O; read the P_source axis at O.

add_only.meaning: delivered ions add to the beam and each costs the full Hall price V_d/eta_b

cost_offset.meaning: delivered ions add to the beam and avoid the Hall's per-ion electron-current overhead

optimistic_bound.meaning: most favourable corner of the declared box alpha, chi in [0, 1], eta_v_S in [eta_v, 1] (self-check: dominates the box); elimination reference

species.status: analysis mixes: single species, singly charged (real beams mix N2+/N+/O+/NO+ and multiply charged ions; supported by the module, not scanned)

masses.source: CIAAW, Abridged Standard Atomic Weights 2024 (from Atomic Weights 2021 with 2024 revisions): N 14.007 +- 0.001, O 15.999 +- 0.001, Xe 131.29 +- 0.01
masses.transformation: ion mass = sum of atomic weights; electron mass (5.5e-4 u) neglected (relative effect <= 3.4e-5)

P_source_bus_W.status: PROPOSED analysis range (assumed; not a prediction, not a design value); span requested by the owner (0-500 W); read as the total overhead O

eta_transport.status: PROPOSED analysis range (assumed; not a prediction, not a design value); span requested by the owner (0.1-1)

V_d_V.status: PROPOSED analysis range (assumed; not a prediction, not a design value)

context.source: Brabston et al., JPP 2025, doi:10.2514/1.B39623, Table 2 (N1-N5), via hallthruster_bridge/identification/brabston_p5_n2_measurement_audit_v1.json
context.use: context only: lies inside the V_d analysis range; P5 (3-5 kW, 5.0-5.4 mg/s) is outside the RFP power class and is not an axis

mdot_mg_s.status: PROPOSED analysis range (assumed; not a prediction, not a design value)

rfp_bracket.source: RFP DTDF/06/13516 Part III Para 2 as encoded in abep_sim/constants.py RFPConstraints
rfp_bracket.reading: the range starts above the definitional minimum and its top end corresponds to eta_a ~ 4 % at 25 mN and 1.5 kW

eta_u0.status: PROPOSED analysis range (assumed; not a prediction, not a design value)

context.evidence_class: reconstructed (thrust-stand, ExB and RPA data reduced with the authors' model)
context.source: Hofer & Gallimore, AIAA-2004-3602, abstract (component ranges, 300-900 V) and Sec. IV.A (Xe, 10 mg/s anode flow), https://pepl.engin.umich.edu/pdf/AIAA-2004-3602.pdf (accessed 2026-09-26)
context.definition_note: Hofer's eta_v (Eq. 6) is the conversion of voltage into AXIALLY directed velocity, so it absorbs divergence; in breakeven_v1 divergence is the separate factor gamma_div (G&K Eq. 2.3-15). Not directly comparable; context only.
context.use: context only: xenon, 5 kW class; shows the order of the components the analysis sets bracket

eta_b.status: PROPOSED analysis range (assumed; not a prediction, not a design value)

eta_v.status: PROPOSED analysis range (assumed; not a prediction, not a design value); add_only and cost_offset do not depend on eta_v (self-check 3)

gamma_div.status: PROPOSED analysis range (assumed; not a prediction, not a design value); no break-even quantity depends on it (self-check 3)

eta_ppu_discharge.status: PROPOSED analysis range (assumed; not a prediction, not a design value); enters only via P_d_bus0 = P_d/eta and Pi_H = V_d/(eta_b eta): another value equals rescaling V_d by 0.9/eta

omega_fixed.status: PROPOSED analysis range (assumed; not a prediction, not a design value)

notes.omega: O / P_d_bus0: total bus overhead over the Hall-only discharge bus power
notes.C_del_star_over_Pi_H: break-even bus cost per ampere delivered into the Hall beam when the whole overhead O = omega P_d_bus0 is spent in the generator; at omega = 0 the marginal (delta_s -> 0) value
notes.sup_with_fixed_overhead: sup over the delivered share of the break-even cost when a fixed (non-ion-scaling) overhead omega_fixed P_d_bus0 is present; <= 0 means that no positive source cost pays
notes.keys: case|eta_u0|eta_b|eta_v; add_only and cost_offset are independent of eta_v

dimensional.C_del_star_bus_W_per_A: exact, not stored: P_source * eta_u0 / (delta_eta_u_star * I_b0_A) for P_source > 0 (alpha = 1 in every case; I_b0_A from hall_reference_table); at P_source = 0 it is Pi_H_bus_W_per_A * universal.marginal_C_del_star_over_Pi_H
dimensional.C_src_star: C_src*(eta_t) = eta_t * C_del_star_bus_W_per_A for every eta_t in inputs.eta_transport
dimensional.null_means: no break-even: overhead >= Hall-only discharge bus power (omega >= 1) or the required gain exceeds the utilization cap (eta_u <= 1)

procedure: convert the published cost to bus W per A with bus_referred_source_cost (power reference absorbed/forward/bus; eV/ion / mean charge); every chain efficiency explicit
pair it with eta_transport on the SAME ion basis (produced / source-exit / extracted -> accelerated in the Hall beam)

C_del = C_src / eta_t; compare with C_del* = Pi_H * c(omega) (universal) or the dimensional C_del_star_bus_W_per_A; the supremum over any spend is the marginal value Pi_H * marginal_C_del_star_over_Pi_H when there is no fixed overhead
C_del above the optimistic_bound supremum: cannot pay in power at that Hall point within the model family (milestone-A elimination candidate, conditional on the assumptions)
place_evidence() returns the payable delivered-share interval and the minimum eta_t
evidence_placement.overlay: none in this file (reproducible from the repository alone); a PRELIMINARY overlay is written to breakeven_evidence_overlay_prelim_v1.json only when --evidence-matrix is given

mass_breakeven.inequality: s_P * dP_bus_saved (equal thrust) or s_T * dT (equal bus power) - dm_propellant >= m_source_head + m_generator_PPU + m_magnets + m_interstage + m_thermal_added

inputs.s_P_kg_per_W: TBD - requires power-system sizing (arrays, PCDU, thermal) at the mission point (milestone C)
inputs.hardware masses: TBD - requires source, PPU and magnet designs with evidence
inputs.dm_propellant: 0 for the air arm by definition (no stored air); TBD for the Xe mode

mass_breakeven.surface: none (no sourced sensitivities); function mass_breakeven() evaluates it once the inputs exist

inequalities: min(arm limits) >= k_q * t_fire,req  (requirement; t_fire,req = 15000 h from the RFP, k_q PROPOSED/TBD)
life_breakeven.inputs: Hall wall erosion life at both operating points (J_i Y(eps_i), G&K Eq. 7.5-1; needs wall_life_trustworthy Hall maps), source life limits (RF window/antenna erosion and coating, generator; ECR window, magnets, microwave generator), cathode, PPU: all TBD

optimistic_corner_dominates_box.box: alpha, chi in {0, 0.5, 1}; eta_v_S in {eta_v, mid, 1}
